analysis.reasonEn: The past 3 trading days closed lower. The daily RSI has entered oversold territory at 38.3, but the MACD histogram remains in weak territory at -11.9924. Volume at 0.40 of the 5-day average indicates a lack of directional conviction. A break below the 25,055 swing support level could lead to further declines.
